verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a hosted product-data API with an SDK, CLI and MCP server, so whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence mentions a public source repository or an open-source license for any part of the product. The published OpenAPI spec and llms.txt are API documentation, not source code under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
